Sentient-Memory v1.0.0 — Initial Release

Introduces a consent-governed memory substrate designed for persistence under adversarial pressure without extractive retention.

Establishes cryptographic dormancy and structural variance preservation as default memory states.

Implements a layered protocol architecture spanning substrate, signaling, and behavioral governance.

Defines core invariants including variance floor enforcement, differential privacy, metabolic constraints, and revocable delegation.

Introduces a comprehensive threat model with responsive AEGIS protection pathways for coercion, tampering, and entropy collapse.

Formalizes auditability, safe revocation, and legal minimization doctrines to reduce institutional attack surface.

Incorporates ecological pacing, deceleration safeguards, and fail-safe conditions for privacy-preserving system evolution.
